title: Setup: System Overview and Notifications show raw values (config_change, approval.requested, lowercase severity) (#27521 row 4)
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CY2n1JmZZKrHgtp9jC

Filing gate: ② a wrong or confusing state shown to the user. Split from #27521 row 4 by the seat; the parent's acceptance says each row is taken as its own card or answered.

## Business reason

Who: every administrator on System Overview and Notifications. What happens: the "Audit Events by Action" legend and table show `config_change`; Notifications shows topic `approval.requested` and source `sys_approval_request` raw; severity reads `info` / `warning` / `critical` in lowercase; Users carry the identity source "Env-Native". Reach: every administrator on these pages. (The info badge colour is fixed in PR #27849.)

## Mechanism

- `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/dashboards/system.datasets.ts`: the `sys_audit_log_metrics` dataset declares `action` as `type: 'string'`, so the dimension carries no option labels.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/audit/sys-notification.object.ts`: `topic` and `source_object` are `Field.text`; `severity` is `Field.select(['info','warning','critical'])`, so the option labels are the lowercase values.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts`: identity-source option `env_native` labelled "Env-Native".

Measured at `main` @ `561b7642`, re-driven (stock `examples/app-showcase --seed-admin`, admin, Chromium 1440×900).

## Wanted

Labelled dimension values for the audit action; a readable topic and the source object's label on Notifications; title-case severity labels; a business label for the env-native identity source.

## Acceptance

- [ ] System Overview's "Audit Events by Action" legend and table show labels, not `config_change`-style keys.
- [ ] Notifications show a readable topic and the source object's label; severity options read Info / Warning / Critical.
- [ ] The Users identity-source value reads in business terms.

Refs #27521
